title: Deactivate acts at once and moves the term to the Inactive tab
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • Make sure Net 45 is active (customers and vendors may hold it).
  • Before you start, write down the Active tab's count (number A) and the Inactive tab's count (number B).
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If you cannot set up any of the above, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the "Net 45" row.
  2. Click "Deactivate".
  3. Click the "Inactive" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The menu opens.

Step 2:

  • No confirmation opens.
  • The Net 45 row leaves the Active tab, the Active count reads number A − 1 and the Inactive count number B + 1 (for example 13 and 3), and a green toast shows "Net 45 deactivated".

Step 3:

  • Net 45 is listed on the Inactive tab in its usual place.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11671 (Story 2, Row menu actions)

  • S2-R7: “"Deactivate" acts at once, without a confirmation: the term moves to the Inactive tab, both tab counts update, and a success toast shows "{name} deactivated". Every customer and vendor on the term keeps it (Story 5: New Customer and Edit Customer, Story 6: Vendors).”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Term deactivated | "{name} deactivated" | Success toast”
  • Key Decisions: “Deleting a term asks for confirmation; deactivating, reactivating and making a term the default are confirmed only where the result is not obvious. Delete is permanent and asks first. Deactivate and Reactivate are reversible and act at once with a toast. Make Default confirms, because its effect on existing customers (none) needs saying.”
  • Key Decisions: “Any other standard term (Net 7 to Net 120) can be deactivated to shorten the pickers.”
